$comment: Which mark goes where. Vocabulary for every product: full = sign + wordmark, icon = sign alone, logotype = wordmark alone, card = the padded 5:3 version for og/social. Every product icon carries the Box Of Rules sign path from marks/box-of-rules/icon-*.svg, unchanged. If a surface is not listed, ask James; never invent, redraw or recolour a mark.

marks.use: the default Box Of Rules mark on any public Box Of Rules surface: org profile, press, docs, og cards, the music site
marks.never: dark backgrounds where blue fails contrast: use full-white

marks.use: on ink/coal when the blue does not read
print and light paper only
favicons, app icons, avatars, tight corners; PNG beside it for raster targets. THE sign: every product icon is built from this path
icon on ink/coal
print only
the word-form beside a product full logo (the 'from Box Of Rules' line), headers
